name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "Eventually the door is opened." (Existence(door_open)) is redundant. Because the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together with Existence(target_picked_up) already guarantees that door_open must occur before the box is picked up, the existence of door_open is implied and need not be explicitly stated. Remove this clause and keep the other two hard clauses.

texts: Eventually pick up the target box.
